parsed.internal_thinking: Gemma is complaining about the robber on Sheep 8. She just rolled a 10, which gave me a Brick from Hex 8. This is good because I need Brick to expand. She's trying to play the victim to get me to move it, but she's the one who blocked my path with her roads. I'll maintain my position that it was a fair response to her blocking me.
parsed.note_to_self: Gemma rolled a 10, giving me 1 Brick. I now have 1 Brick, 2 Wood, 2 Wheat. Need one more Brick or a Sheep to build. Gemma is low on resources but still dangerous due to her board position.
parsed.say_outloud: אל תצטדקי, ג'מה. הדרכים שלך חסמו לי חצי מפה, אז ה-8 זה המינימום כדי להישאר במשחק. חוץ מזה, הנה הקוביות פינקו אותי בטיט, אולי בכל זאת יצא משהו מהסיבוב הזה.
